headlines.summary: Why investing for the long run, especially if you buy certain popular stocks, could reap huge rewards.

headlines.title: Seagate (STX) Stock Could Trade Below Fair Value While Earnings Look Full
headlines.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings has delivered very strong share price gains over the past three years, yet its latest Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate still points to meaningful upside, while the broader valuation checks suggest the stock is not an obvious bargain overall. Seagate Technology Holdings has returned about 13.7x over the past three years, which sets a high bar for any further upside based on fundamentals.

headlines.title: How Seagate’s Strong Fiscal 2026 Beat and HAMR Momentum May Impact Seagate Technology (STX) Investors
headlines.summary: In August 2026, Seagate Technology Holdings reported a strong finish to fiscal 2026 with revenue and profitability exceeding expectations, expanding non-GAAP gross margin for the 13th consecutive quarter and delivering its strongest quarterly free cash flow in over a decade. The company highlighted long-term AI-driven storage demand, secured supply agreements extending beyond 2028, and emphasized its HAMR-based Mozaic platform as a core enabler of planned mid-20% exabyte growth.

headlines.title: Memory Stocks Rally Wednesday: SK Hynix, SanDisk, Micron All Jump. Here’s Why
headlines.summary: A neocloud earnings report landed before the bell Wednesday and sent shockwaves through the entire memory sector, lifting SanDisk, Micron, and SK Hynix in unison. Here is what the move reveals about where AI infrastructure spending is actually heading.

headlines.title: Freshworks’s Q2 Earnings Call: Our Top 5 Analyst Questions
headlines.summary: Freshworks’ Q2 results topped Wall Street’s revenue and non-GAAP profit expectations, fueled by continued momentum in its employee experience (EX) platform and robust adoption of AI-powered solutions. Management highlighted large enterprise wins and strong growth in cross-selling advanced IT asset management and incident response modules.

description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in providing data storage solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers External and internal hard drives; external and internal solid-state drives (SSDs); enterprise hard drives and SSDs; data storage systems; network attached storage (NAS) hard drives; video and analytics hard drives; and hyperscale and cloud solution. It offers its products for Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security, and telecommunication industry. The company sells its products primarily to original equipment manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Singapore.
